findings.title: endOfDay returns the start of the next day
findings.body: The new implementation sets `end` to the start of the given day and then adds one day, so `endOfDay(day)` returns the start of the next day instead of the end of the current day. This breaks the function's contract and any code relying on it.

summary.problem: The refactored `endOfDay` now returns the start of the next day instead of the end of the current day.
summary.done_well: The change reuses `startOfDay` to avoid duplication, but the logic is incorrect for the intended purpose.
